propositions: rebar must support encrypted S3 buckets as ticket-store remote via git-remote-s3 helper, with init/mount/create/claim/push/fetch succeeding against s3:// URLs and data residing only in the encrypted bucket

concurrent/legacy pushes can create multiple bundle files for one ref, causing git ls-remote to return the ref at multiple SHAs and fresh clones to fail with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed', rendering the store unclonable

when sync.remote is an s3:// URL and git-remote-s3 helper is absent or below the minimum required version, store init and push must fail closed with an actionable message naming the exact pip install command

the multiple-bundles state must self-heal non-interactively by merging all divergent heads under a repo-level repair lock, ensuring exactly one bundle per ref, successful fresh clones, and full reachability of all commits from all divergent heads

operators must be able to enable and configure the S3 backend from documentation alone, including optional [s3] dependency declaration, minimum helper version requirements, SSE-KMS bucket setup, and sync.remote=s3://… configuration
